entries.title: Psalms 146:1
segments:
PSALM CXLVI. 
 
  The psalmist praises God, and exhorts all to trust in him alone,   ver. 1-5.   Because of his power, faithfulness and everlasting kingdom, ver. 6-10.

entries.title: Psalms 146:4
segments: V. 4. That day-As soon as ever he is dead.  Thoughts-All his designs and endeavours either for himself or for others.

entries.title: Psalms 146:6
segments: V. 6. For ever-Both because he liveth for ever to fulfil his promises, and because he is eternally faithful.
